'''343.245/H5''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]]. During the [[Battle of Turak IV]], this commander was in command of a team of two squads, [[Squad 5-Aurek]] and [[Squad 5-Cresh]], that were sent to retrieve a downed, but still operational, [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsor tank]], the [[Hammer 4:3]]. 343.245/H5 was also under orders to eliminate any opposition and bring the tank's crew safely home.
